headline: The tone is honest and calm and I trust it more than the brokers, but what it promises is fewer, better alerts, and finding listings was never my problem; knowing what I'm signing from Dubai is.
must_fix: Make guarantor fit part of the core promise: let me match on 'accepts third-party guarantor' and say plainly in the alert when that is known and when it isn't. Without it, most of the matches are useless to me.

Make 'budget' mean the true monthly cost (rent, likely utilities such as electric heat, fees, and the guarantor cost), or at least say clearly what is and isn't counted. A listing that 'fits my budget' and then adds $600 at move-in is exactly what I'm afraid of.

Bring the 'Core insight' into the positioning itself: say that each alert separates what the listing claims from what JIMS can source, such as public building complaints, and names where each fact comes from. As written, the promise stops at 'here is a listing', and I already get that from StreetEasy at 3am.
would_flip_me: Add one line to the positioning promising that every alert shows whether the listing accepts third-party guarantors and an estimated all-in monthly cost, with the source of each fact labelled. That gets me to approve.
in_character_reaction: I really appreciate that you won't say 'verified' and that you admit an alert doesn't replace a tour. That already makes me trust you more than the brokers. But I'm signing from Dubai with a guarantor company and a flight date. My problem isn't missing listings, it's finding out about the mice and the electric heat after I sign. If an alert just tells me 'this matches your filters,' it saves me some refreshing, but it doesn't stop me from regretting the lease.
